messages.subject: Re: shiny server returns NA to client (kills JSON) for app where shiny standalone doesn't
parts:
Hello, I've just resolved what might be the same issue. 

The websocket message (socket.onmessage) returned was NA instead of valid JSON and I tracked it down to being illegal \ characters being returned from a renderText call in server.R

hope that helps!
